snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 4, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

Happy 2nd Anniversary to Maimaimaigoen! We're jumping right into our Episode 4 playthrough! 

When searching for a new attraction, you can check any previous attraction for different dialogue. Translations for the Twilight Alley, Block Answer, and Merry-Go-Circuit dialogue can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jth9euYHKhg

Thank you for watching, demi! 

--

Episode 4 - Well Wishes

After losing another friend to Merry-Go-Circuit, they are all tormented by mental anguish. Despite this, they have to keep collecting medals. Okada Yu, along with Lion, Lime, and Zoya, try out a new attraction called "Heartpoundin' Ferris Wheel." A few other children join them to take on the high-risk Bye Bye Slots attraction that gives them a chance to win more medals...

With the former members of the Wolf Team joining, a "New Goat Team" is formed, and Okada and the children reunite once again! But after the Bye Bye Slots attraction, a crack appears between the newly combined group...

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Okada Yu, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with his students.  As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly distorted... They wander into the mysterious amusement park Uropia where they're confronted by a strange yet oddly cute creature called "Froggy Egg." To escape from Uropia, he and the children must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 medals...

--
